Wizards of Erenor look to Aranzeb, the elven master mage and keeper of magic, as the father of Sorcery. In the tradition he founded, a sorcerer turns fire, ice and lightning into weapons, raining storms and meteors down on whole battlefields. Sorcery is one of the three primary DPS skill trees, with a heavy emphasis on AoE magic damage. It deals that damage through a mix of powerful cast skills and instant skills. The tree has very little crowd control and utility of its own, so it is usually paired with trees that fill those gaps. Wizards of Erenor look to Aranzeb, the elven master mage and keeper of magic, as the father of Sorcery. In the tradition he founded, a sorcerer turns fire, ice and lightning into weapons, raining storms and meteors down on whole battlefields.

Sorcery is one of the three primary DPS skill trees, with a heavy emphasis on AoE magic damage. It deals that damage through a mix of powerful cast skills and instant skills. The tree has very little crowd control and utility of its own, so it is usually paired with trees that fill those gaps.
